integration.title: Integration status
integration.subtitle: ICF Global member sync, email safety gates and the one-time cutover to live data.
integration.frozen: Cutover in progress — member data is frozen
integration.redirectInbox: Redirect all member email to this inbox (optional)
integration.runSyncOverrideConfirm: Run the sync and skip the feed-drop safety check for this run only? Use this only when you know a large drop in the ICF feed is correct.
integration.cleanupConfirm: Anonymise every member whose grace period has expired? This cannot be undone.
integration.cutoverBody: A one-time, irreversible switch. Configuration, vocabularies and published content are preserved; all test member data and test accounts are archived and then removed.
integration.cutoverStep1: Confirm test mode and that live credentials are configured.
integration.cutoverStep2: Archive the full member domain into a restorable snapshot.
integration.cutoverStep4: Purge member tables and delete non-staff test accounts.
integration.cutoverStep5: Switch to live mode with email and account claim still closed.
integration.cutoverStep6: Run the first live member import.
integration.cutoverStep7: Validate: no test-shaped emails, no pre-linked accounts, vocabularies intact.
integration.cutoverStep8: Unfreeze the directory. Email and account claim stay closed until separately decided.
integration.rehearseBody: Non-destructive dry run: checks pre-flight, takes an archive snapshot, and reports exactly what a real cutover would delete, unbind and switch. Nothing is purged and the integration stays in TEST mode.
integration.rehearseDone: Rehearsal complete — no data was changed.
integration.ownBody: Articles and events owned by an account that go-live would remove. Reassign them to a staff author; the cutover is never blocked by this list.
integration.ownEmpty: Nothing to reassign — all content is owned by staff accounts.
integration.runDetailEmpty: No per-member detail was recorded for this run.
integration.runDetailLegacy: Runs from before the detailed log was introduced show counts and events only.
integration.runSearch: Filter by name or ICF number…
integration.runTruncated: Only the first 1000 rows are shown.
integration.gatesBody: The two switches that open member email and account claiming. The database refuses both in test mode, and claiming also requires a completed cutover.
integration.gateEmailOpenConfirm: Send member email for real? Every claim invitation and notice will go to the member's own address.
integration.gateClaimOpenConfirm: Open account claiming for all members? They will be able to bind their ICF record to a login.
integration.gateReasonNoCutover: Blocked until the cutover is completed.
integration.gateReasonFrozen: Blocked while the cutover is in progress.
integration.healthBody: Read-only status of the ICF member sync: last run, whether the relay answers, our outbound address, the last credential check, and the endpoint in use. No secret value is shown.
integration.healthEgressNote: ICF whitelists the relay's fixed address
integration.egressBody: The address ICF sees when this app connects to their SOAP service, checked separately for IPv4 and IPv6. It can change between runs, so check a few times. Every sync run also logs both addresses.
integration.egressAgreed: Both services report the same address.
integration.egressDisagree: The services report different addresses — the outbound address is not stable.
integration.egressNoIpv4: No IPv4 address could be determined — outbound traffic may be IPv6 only.
integration.egressNoIpv6: No IPv6 address could be determined.
integration.egressIcfDual: resolves to both IPv4 and IPv6.
integration.egressIcfIpv4Only: resolves to IPv4 only, so our connection must leave over IPv4.
integration.credBody: Runs only the ICF login step, from the same runtime as the nightly sync. Use it to tell a mis-pasted secret or a wrong login endpoint apart from an account ICF has disabled. No credential value is ever shown or logged.
integration.credSecretsClean: Stored secrets look clean — no stray whitespace or line breaks.
integration.campaignBody: Invites members to claim their account in bounded daily waves — pilot members first, then by membership start date. Reminders go to members who have not claimed.
integration.campaignStartConfirm: Start sending claim invitations in daily waves?

campaignGate.cutover_in_progress: Blocked: a cutover is in progress.
campaignGate.claim_closed: Blocked: account claiming is still closed.
campaignGate.emails_suppressed: Blocked: member email is suppressed with no redirect inbox.
